fields.pagetitle: Moments from our basic dermopigmentation course

tvs.description-banner-inerial:
Here are some moments from our basic dermopigmentation course. You can see and assess the level of training and the way our classes are taught – and sign up if you're interested.

Please note that all the necessary equipment, tools and accessories are included in the course price. We provide:

  • a space for practical classes, fully furnished and with professional lighting;
  • areas with upholstered chairs for taking notes during theory classes;
  • a professional micropigmentation machine – the same one we use in our own work;
  • pigments in a range of shades for brow, lip and eyelid micropigmentation;
  • a latex practice pad for the first stage of practice;
  • all single-use consumables: gloves, masks, sheets, etc.;
  • notebooks and pens for taking notes.

So you won't have to spend a thing. We've thought of absolutely everything, right down to the snacks during coffee breaks. These moments from our basic dermopigmentation course are further proof of the quality of our training and of the care we take to make every student comfortable. Sign up for the course, become a professional micropigmentation artist and start enjoying the benefits of a new profession.
